intervals.label: construction
intervals.note: The start of construction is not given in any source fetched; the pond was completed in early 1999.
intervals.quote: The construction of the Milagro pond was completed in early 1999, and operations began in mid 1999.

intervals.label: operation
intervals.note: Start: the status paper says operations began in mid 1999 and the pond has operated continuously since January 2000; the 2011 Crab paper and the HAWC design paper state "operated from 2000 to 2008". The 1999 start is kept; the end is 2008 in both.
intervals.quote: The construction of the Milagro pond was completed in early 1999, and operations began in mid 1999.

intervals.label: data taking ended
intervals.note: The central reservoir was operated alone from 2000 to 2004, after which the outrigger array was added (arXiv:1110.0409).

name: Milagro water-Cherenkov pond and outriggers
notes: The water-tank outrigger count varies between sources (170 in the 2001 status paper); it is not recorded here.

placements.note: Site-level coordinate only; see the site record.
placements.quote: The detector was located at 106.68o W longitude, 35.88o N latitude in northern New Mexico at an altitude of 2630 m above sea level

altitude.quote: at an altitude of 2630 m above sea level

energy_range.quote: was sensitive to approximately 100 GeV - 100 TeV gamma ray air showers
energy_range.value: about 100 GeV - 100 TeV gamma-ray air showers

pmt_count.quote: The core of the detector is a 60m x 80m x 8m pond instrumented with 723 PMTs deployed in two layers.

description.quote: The sensitive area of the detector comprised two parts: a central water reservoir and an “outrigger” array of water tanks
description.value: An outrigger array of water tanks, instrumented with 8-inch PMTs, surrounding the central reservoir.

summary.plain: A covered pond of purified water lined with 723 light sensors in two layers, plus a ring of outlying water tanks, that sensed the faint blue flashes from air showers.
summary.technical: Central 60 m x 80 m x 8 m water reservoir with 723 8-inch PMTs in two layers (top layer for direction, bottom layer for gamma/hadron discrimination) and an outrigger array of water tanks instrumented with the same PMTs.

technology.quote: The core of the detector is a 60m x 80m x 8m pond instrumented with 723 PMTs deployed in two layers.
technology.value: Water-Cherenkov air-shower array: a covered 60 m x 80 m x 8 m pond with 723 PMTs in two layers, plus an outrigger array of water tanks.
